morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在词首 b 前变为 mem-，b 保留；词根两个 é 均为 /e/。输入包把派生词标为词根，现据 DBP 的 bebel 词条纠正。[DBP 词根条目](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=bebel)

senses.zh_definition: 絮絮叨叨地说话，话语杂乱或难以理解；嘟囔。
senses.en_definition: To speak ramblingly or unintelligibly; to mutter or babble.
senses.ms_definition: Mengeluarkan kata-kata secara tidak tersusun atau sukar difahami; mengomel.
senses.nuances: 强调话语杂乱、含混或持续嘟囔，不等于普通聊天。

senses.zh_definition: 反复唠叨、数落或抱怨，常含不满或责备。
senses.en_definition: To nag, grumble, or repeatedly complain or scold.
senses.ms_definition: Berleter atau mengomel berulang-ulang, biasanya kerana tidak puas hati.
senses.nuances: 日常最常见的意思。说某人在 membebel，通常带有说话者觉得烦的评价；并不必然表示对方声音很大或说话没有道理。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场 / 内部沟通培训
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam sesi latihan itu, penyelia diminta memberikan arahan yang jelas tanpa membebel tentang kesilapan yang sama.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在那次培训中，主管被要求清楚地下达指示，避免针对同样的错误反复数落。
dual_scenarios.en: During the training session, supervisors were asked to give clear instructions without repeatedly nagging about the same mistakes.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Mak dah membebel sebab bilik aku bersepah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Ibu sudah mula berleter kerana bilikku bersepah.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我房间乱糟糟的，妈妈已经开始念我了。
dual_scenarios.en: Mum’s started nagging me because my room’s a mess.
spoken_features: mak 是 ibu 的日常称呼
bilik aku 是熟人交流中自然的领属表达

messages.speaker: Amir (哥哥)
messages.ms_spoken: Mak dah membebel sebab bilik aku bersepah.
messages.ms_standard: Ibu sudah mula berleter kerana bilikku bersepah.
messages.zh: 我房间乱糟糟的，妈妈已经开始念我了。
messages.en: Mum’s started nagging me because my room’s a mess.

messages.speaker: Aina (妹妹)
messages.ms_spoken: Kemas je sekarang. Nanti mak tak membebel lagi.
messages.ms_standard: Kemaslah bilik itu sekarang supaya ibu tidak berleter lagi.
messages.zh: 现在收拾一下呗，妈妈就不会继续念了。
messages.en: Just tidy it up now, then Mum won’t keep nagging.

etymology.historical_story: Membebel is transparently built from bebel with the Malay verbal prefix meN-. Dictionaries connect it both with disordered speech and with berleter, or nagging. Its everyday force comes from repeated talk: a complaint returns, then returns again. The repeated be sounds offer a useful mnemonic, although they do not prove an imitative historical origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听见 be-bel、be-bel 连着响，就像同一句抱怨反复播放：membebel＝唠叨个不停。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 直接对长辈或上司说 jangan membebel 可能显得顶撞。需要回应提醒时，可说 Baik, saya faham 或 Saya akan uruskan。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 朋友或家人私下可用来打趣，但当面称别人的关心或合理提醒为 membebel，容易让人觉得被轻视。
